data.cultural_impact: The name "Mort" has a strong cultural significance rooted in the history of the English language and medieval literature. This name was commonly used to signify the personification of death, with the character often depicted as a skeleton or a hooded figure. As such, the name "Mort" came to represent the inevitability of death and the passing of life.
